title: CastillosBurstVEP100
description: A 12-participant EEG dataset of a 4-class code-modulated visual evoked potential (c-VEP) reactive brain-computer interface study. It compares burst c-VEP sequences with m-sequences at 100% and 40% amplitude depth. Data were recorded with a 32-channel BrainProducts LiveAmp system at 500 Hz and used to evaluate CNN-based decoding, calibration duration, and user experience.
methods_description: Twelve healthy participants completed an offline 4-class c-VEP protocol with a factorial design (burst vs m-sequence, 100% vs 40% amplitude depth). EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a 32-channel BrainProducts LiveAmp, and stimuli were presented with PsychoPy on a 60 Hz monitor. Participants focused on cued targets in random order across blocks. Decoding used a CNN with 250 ms sliding windows and Pearson correlation for target selection.
